subject.name: Jordan Rivers
subject.headline: Backend-focused platform engineer who owns the event-ingestion core end to end — from the append-only log and replay tooling to the on-call runbooks — and directs AI generation to production quality.

project.name: Beacon
project.description: Beacon is an event-ingestion platform for retail point-of-sale systems: it collects transaction events, replays them for reconciliation, and exposes a query API for downstream reporting. The codebase is a TypeScript monorepo serving one ingestion service and one query API, in production since early 2024.

claims.claim: Designed the event-sourcing core that both the ingestion service and the query API replay from.
Rewrote the batch-replay path to stream from Kafka instead of loading full snapshots, cutting reconciliation time from hours to minutes.
Directs AI-assisted generation of the MCP tool surface and refines the output through hand-authored validation and error handling.

evidence.description: The event-sourcing core: append-only log, snapshotting, and replay — split into testable pure modules.
Introduced the append-only event log and the replay interface the query API consumes.
9-commit migration streaming batch replay from Kafka instead of full snapshots.
6 sequences of AI-co-authored MCP tool scaffolding followed by subject-authored validation and error-handling commits on the same files.
